propositions: _repair_ticket bypasses rebuild_with_restore and calls rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log directly, so it fails to restore deleted SNAPSHOT sources that could be recovered
rebuild_with_restore is documented as the repair path's single entrypoint but only one of two call sites uses it; _repair_ticket represents an undocumented divergence
_repair_ticket must route through rebuild_with_restore while preserving the no_commit contract so batch repair defers commits until after the whole batch completes
rebuild_with_restore requires a keyword-only no_commit parameter to forward through to rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, defaulting to False to preserve repair_or_plan's current behavior
_repair_ticket must surface restored filenames in its disp dict returned to callers, mirroring what repair_or_plan already exposes
